title: Privileged ops sandbox with staged simulations
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Build a guarded, reproducible privileged-ops sandbox that executes admin utilities and runbooks as first-class tasks in a staged simulation mode before permitting live execution. The feature should let SREs/support engineers rehearse remediation flows against synthetic state, review the exact commandlet sequence, preview telemetry side-effects, and optionally run a permissioned dry-run with audit logging. This reduces blast radius for automated repairs and accelerates operator onboarding for complex remediation playbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Sandbox can load a runbook-as-task (YAML/JSON task graph) and run in 'simulation' mode with no live mutations
Operator can perform a 'staged rehearsal' that advances steps manually and inspects intended API calls/DB writes before committing
System produces deterministic replay artifacts (inputs, seq of actions, KV diffs) that can be stored and rerun for postmortem
RBAC gates enforce that only users with 'privileged-sandbox:execute' may transition a rehearsal into a live pilot
All dry-runs produce an auditable snapshot in the central audit log and a linkable artifact for linking to incidents/PRs
Integration tests simulate 3 common remediation flows and assert zero live side-effects in simulation runs
